question: What is the repeatability ceiling of OlmoEarth single-observation embeddings? If two observations of the same tile a few days apart already differ, no interpolator can be expected to match a held-out observation beyond that ceiling.
data: olmo_streaming_dev/single_fp16, the same 1500-tile seed-0 sample as MS-126; real dates from the contract
measure: token cos between consecutive kept observations, binned by day gap: <=5, 6-10, 11-20, 21-40, 41-70, 71-120, >120; also same-calendar-month pairs
ceiling_definition: mean cos of pairs with gap <= 10 days (short enough that surface change is negligible for most tiles; cloud/atmosphere/geometry differences remain)
normalised_gain: (cos_model - cos_linear) / (ceiling - cos_linear) computed from MS-130 (resmlp seed mean, test regions) and MS-126 (linear, dev sample); reported descriptively
not_claimed: that <=10-day pairs have zero surface change
